_comment: One object per COMPANY. A promotion or role change is another entry in that company's `roles` array — the org name, blurb and spine marker are not repeated. Skills are deliberately absent — half of them already appear inside an achievement, and the resume PDF covers keyword breadth better than a list of bare nouns can. `essay` is a slug in src/posts/essays/; if no post matches the line renders as plain text, so this file can never link to writing that does not exist. No item sets `essay` right now — the field is still supported, add it back to a line once the matching post exists.
